name: Windows 11 Taskbar
author: geovane
description: A Windows 11-style application taskbar bar widget: pinned and running apps grouped per application, hover thumbnails, and a right-click jump list.

barWidget.description: Pinned + running applications, grouped per app, with hover previews and jump lists.

schema.label: Smallest icon size (px)
schema.description: Resting size of an app icon when it is not magnified.

schema.label: Biggest icon size (px)
schema.description: Peak size the icon directly under the pointer grows to.

schema.label: Magnify on hover (wave)
schema.description: Grow icons near the pointer in a dock-style wave that can overflow the bar.

schema.label: Wave falloff range
schema.description: How many neighboring icons share the wave (icons).

schema.label: Hover preview delay (ms)
schema.description: How long to hover an app icon before its window preview appears.
